SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, DS_SEQ FROM ICOMPORS WHERE BUYER = 'KRHSDE0003' AND DS_SEQ = '000001' AND SEND_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT SUBSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,1,INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,1)-1) as PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID, SUBSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,1)+1,INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,2)-INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,1)-1) as REVISION_NUM, PORS.ADD_DATE as CONFIRM_DATE, 'Y' AS ORDER_CONFIRMATION, PORS.DS_DATE AS SUPPLIER_SUGGEST_DATE, null AS SUPPLIER_REMARK FROM ICOMPORS PORS, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT WHERE PORS.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PORS.PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PORS.PO_SEQ= '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND PORS.DS_SEQ= '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$' AND PORS.STATUS ^= 'D' AND PORS.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PORS.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PORS.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ= PRDT.PR_SEQ
UPDATE ICOMPORS SET SEND_FLAG = 'Y' , SEND_DATE = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , SEND_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PO_SEQ= '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND DS_SEQ= '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$'
UPDATE ICOMPORS SET SEND_FLAG = 'E' , SEND_DATE = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , SEND_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PO_SEQ= '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND DS_SEQ= '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$'
